title: Preserve independent raw IMU events and original sensor clocks

scope.android: Independent accelerometer and gyroscope listeners (100 Hz requested each, maxReportLatencyUs=0); one RawMotionEvent per SensorEvent with the exact SensorEvent.timestamp, values, accuracy and per-sensor event ID; per-sensor bounded queues; frame-independent writer drain; SA-50 MotionEvent v1.1 JSON on /stateaction/imu/{accel,gyro}; paired /device/imu sensor_msgs/Imu removed; raw_motion evidence (requested/effective rates, intervals, gaps, non-increasing timestamps, delivered/written/dropped by reason, queue high water, sensor identity, SA-50 inventory states) in metadata.json; queue saturation and stop uncertainty are sticky capture failures with a reason and stop further capture.
scope.ios: Out of this PR by root decision (Android E2E first). No iOS source changes. An unqualified local checkpoint (portable Foundation-only RawMotion seam, Linux Swift 6.1.2 checks, fused/derived stream provenance) is preserved on unpublished branch wanghujie/sa-53-ios-raw-motion-checkpoint at 774cb72 for later iOS parity after the shared contract revision (SA-64).

jvm_round_trip_fixture.description: Production collector + MotionDrainCoordinator + MCAPDatasetWriter; accel 100 Hz and gyro ~197 Hz jittered schedules, every third video frame dropped and the rest written 120 ms late; read back by an independent byte-level MCAP parser in the test.
jvm_round_trip_fixture.official_reader_check: scripts/mobile/verify_raw_motion_mcap.py with mcap==1.6.0 and the SA-50 strict MotionEvent schema: ok

emulator_instrumented.avd: stera_ar_api35 (android-35 google_apis x86_64), emulator only, user 0
emulator_instrumented.note: Accelerometer and gyroscope timestamps have distinct phases (first 48908107189 ns vs 48917728404 ns), confirming independent delivery rather than pairing. The ARCore camera loop itself was not run on the emulator.

local_evidence.recorder_lifecycle: MotionCaptureController (delegated to by ArRecorderImpl) is tested with the production collector, drain, MCAPDatasetWriter and RecordingMetricsState.captureFailureReason: saturation halts capture with a reason, refuses resume, writes every admitted event (IDs 0..7) and counts the 4 rejected; the recording is classified failed. An uncertain IMU stop fails the recording; pause flushes before writers pause; a clean stop writes everything without failure.

remaining_gates: Physical Android: effective rates, gravity sign/axes, accuracy states, long-run saturation and thermal behaviour on real hardware (root-coordinated, personal profile only).

Full ArRecorderImpl capture loop with ARCore on a device: the motion lifecycle it delegates to is tested on the JVM, but the ARCore frame loop, Flutter method-channel result and on-device saturation stop are not exercised (SA-51/SA-56).

iOS (deferred): CMDeviceMotion gravity-removed values still feed /device/imu and ARKit-derived /arkit/imu is unchanged; raw CoreMotion acquisition, separately named fused/derived provenance and MCAP output need the shared capture contract revision (SA-64), an Apple framework build and device qualification.
Clock mapping of motion to the capture timeline (mapped_capture_time_ns stays null) belongs to SA-54.
H.264 profile wiring of these channels with Inventory/Close counts belongs to SA-51/SA-56.
